entry.title: PotentialBleed 1.1.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBleed 1.1.0** - **USER presets.** A new USER page with 8 slots: tap **SAVE**, then a slot, to keep the sound you have now; tap a slot to bring it back. Filled slots read USER 1 to USER 8, empty ones EMPTY, and the slot you loaded last is lit. No typing. - The slots are kept in a file beside your VST2 Plugins folder (`PotentialSuite Presets/PotentialBleed.txt`), so every project and every copy of the plugin sees the same slots, and updating the plugin keeps them. - Use the same slot nu

entry.title: PotentialBleed 1.0.0
entry.summary: ## PotentialBleed 1.0.0 The first release: **ghost bleed for your chops**. It hears each hit and adds quiet synthetic residue behind it, so a loop sounds like it came off a real recording. - **Eight sources:** WIRES, CABINET, SOUNDBOARD, TINES, STRINGS, CYMBAL, ROOM and BARS, all generated (no recordings) - **BLEED**, **SENSE** and **CHANCE** set how much leaks in, how hard a hit has to be, and how often it happens. - **DECAY**, **DUCK**, **GAPS**, **TONE**, **TICK** (a needle tick on each hit)
